newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strasbourg air cargo traffic up 10.3 pct Jan-Sept.
newsitem.headline: Strasbourg air cargo traffic up 10.3 pct Jan-Sept.

text.p: Air cargo traffic handled at Strasbourg-Entzheim airport in the first nine months of the year, totalled 5,101 tonnes, up 10.3 percent on the same period in 1995, airport authority figures show.

Air Jet, airline subsidiary of French express distribution company, Jet Services, operates a nightly air cargo service between Strasbourg and Paris/CDG with British Aerospace BAe146QC (quick change) aircraft.
The Alsace airport also features on Air Jet's Paris/CDG-Strasbourg-Montpellier-Rennes-Marseille- Paris/CDG itinerary.
Postal traffic totalled 3,817 tonnes, a decrease of 4.1 percent on 1995 levels.

French airline, L'Aeropostale, carries overnight mail between its Paris-Charles de Gaulle hub and Strasbourg on a regular basis using a Boeing 737QC aircraft. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+544 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
